_comment: Reward machinery. Tokens are consumables held in a count; paid_ok marks those money may carry. mail is the Royal Mail's housekeeping. limits bound a single reward, so a typo in a letter or a balance field is refused rather than delivered.

tokens.name: Energy Potion
tokens.blurb: Refills your energy. Counts as one of the day's refills.

tokens.name: Protection Charter
tokens.blurb: Eight hours in which nobody can raid you. Raiding someone yourself ends it.

tokens.name: Small Flask
tokens.blurb: Restores a tenth of your energy. It is not a refill: the day's refills are untouched.

tokens.name: Great Flask
tokens.blurb: Restores a quarter of your energy. It is not a refill: the day's refills are untouched.

tokens.name: A Friend's Draught
tokens.blurb: A friend's gift: a fiftieth of your energy back. It is not a refill.

tokens.name: Royal Pardon
tokens.blurb: Mends a broken run of daily rewards, as if the missed days had been kept.

tokens.name: Cart Writ
tokens.blurb: Calls one more Tax Cart, opened after the carts already waiting.

tokens.name: Arena Token
tokens.blurb: One more fight in the Honour Arena, held until you spend it.
